title: LRU cache + API client
issue: The dashboard hammers the backend: the same user is fetched several times at once, popular entries keep getting evicted from the cache, and getUsers() crashes.

bugs.summary: get() does not move the entry to most-recently-used.
The in-flight request is registered only after it has been awaited, so concurrent calls are never de-duplicated.
getUsers passes this.getUser unbound to map().
